meta.name: add-mattermost
meta.description: Add a self-hosted or cloud Mattermost bot channel through the Chat SDK bridge, reusing a healthy server when available and linking to official server setup guidance when needed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 Mattermost 机器人接进聊天频道,复用可用服务器并给出搭建指引
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你团队用 Mattermost,想让机器人常驻聊天频道。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team runs Mattermost and wants a bot living in its channels.

howto.what: Claude 会带你把 Mattermost 机器人频道接进 NanoClaw:先探测可复用的服务器、设好 SiteURL、装适配器、建机器人、配置回调与私聊,再构建、重启并验证。接入后支持私聊、频道、线程、文件和审批卡片。
howto.when: 当你想把 Mattermost 加为聊天频道、提到 “add-mattermost”,或想复用已有的 Mattermost 服务器时触发;没找到健康服务器时会先让你照官方指南部署好再回来。

say.text: 帮我把 Mattermost 加成一个新频道
say.note: 它会先探测本地和已配置的服务器

say.text: 就用你检测到的那个服务器
say.note: 需你确认后才会选中该服务器

howto.what_en: Claude adds a Mattermost bot channel: it probes for a reusable server, sets SiteURL, installs the adapter, creates a bot, configures callbacks and the owner DM, then builds, restarts and verifies. Supports DMs, channels and approval cards.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to add Mattermost as a chat channel, mention "add-mattermost", or reuse an existing Mattermost server; if none is healthy it points you to Mattermost's official setup guides first.

say_en.text: Add Mattermost as a new channel for me
say_en.note: It probes local and configured servers first.
Used as the canonical base URL and SiteURL.
